summary: Iter 40 — Cross-Salon Staff History Registry: 19/19 backend tests PASS. UI flows verified for admin (registry page load, banner, register employee, list rows, badge computation display), public /staff-registry (search by Staff ID + phone, masked aadhaar, badge, employment history, PDF button), and manager RBAC (nav hidden + /registry redirects to /dashboard).
action_items: Owner should periodically prune TEST_* / STF-000xx test employees from registry_employees / registry_employments collections (created ~15 by this iter's tests).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~5400 lines — well past 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting the registry module (employees, employments, public search, PDF) into /app/backend/routes/registry.py for maintainability.
_aadhaar_fp uses SHA256 with jwt_secret() as pepper — good, but if JWT_SECRET rotates, all dup-detection breaks silently. Consider a dedicated REGISTRY_PEPPER env var.
PDF fetches remote photo_url synchronously via requests.get inside asyncio.to_thread — OK but no size cap; a malicious photo URL could balloon RAM. Add max content-length check.
registry_list_employees with empty q returns up to 100 employees created by tenant OR any employee they've added an employment for. Consider pagination (currently no cursor).
seed_data_creation: ~10 test employees STF-000xx (TEST Badge G/E/X/D/B, TEST CrossT, TEST Reg One, TEST UI Emp) with employment records. Non-destructive; STF-00001 (Ravi Test Kumar) preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests use time-based unique aadhaars so reruns are safe. UI Playwright: use `page.click(sel)` then `page.keyboard.type()` — direct `page.fill()` sometimes fails to persist controlled React input values on this build. Public search rate limit: 20/10min per IP; PDF: 10/10min. All 19 backend tests are idempotent.
